task.title: Measure task-count and history-depth performance slopes
task.description:
After the local acceptance harness has representative fixtures and explicit cache semantics, measure scaling axes independently instead of inferring them from the 500-by-20 point.

At history depth 20, measure 100, 500, and 1,000 active tasks. At 500 tasks, measure depths 20 and 100. Cover projection-warm exact update, create, move, depend, list, already-synchronized and small-change sync, and cached and full validation. Record latency, Git process count, fixture shape, and object format for every point; distinguish task-count slopes from history-depth slopes.

Acceptance: deterministic SHA-1 and SHA-256 reports contain the complete matrix with setup outside timed commands, use the corrected representative fixture, and identify observed slopes without changing product behavior or inventing thresholds. Create a narrow optimization story only when a measured target miss or slope warrants it.
